typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblcalypsotradeservswapleg_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string,
		LEG_TYPE as string,
		PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY as string,
		FIXED_RATE as double,
		LEG_ID as decimal(38,0),
		MATURITY_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsodbaswapleg
fromcalypsodbaswapleg derive({Copy of MATURITY_DATE} = toString(MATURITY_DATE),
		{Copy of PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE} = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		{Copy of FIXED_RATE} = toString(FIXED_RATE),
		{Copy of LEG_ID} = LEG_ID,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_FAMILY} = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		{Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID),
		{Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE} = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		{Copy of PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY} = PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY,
		{Copy of LEG_TYPE} = LEG_TYPE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		fixed_rate as double,
		product_sub_type as string,
		principal_currency as string,
		product_family as string,
		LEG_ID as string,
		product_type as string,
		LEG_TYPE as string,
		maturity_date as string,
		TRADE_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		fixed_rate = {Copy of FIXED_RATE},
		product_sub_type = {Copy of PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE},
		principal_currency = {Copy of PRINCIPAL_CURRENCY},
		product_family = {Copy of PRODUCT_FAMILY},
		LEG_ID = {Copy of LEG_ID},
		product_type = {Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE},
		LEG_TYPE = {Copy of LEG_TYPE},
		maturity_date = {Copy of MATURITY_DATE},
		TRADE_ID = {Copy of TRADE_ID}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblcalypsotradeservswapleg_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblcalypsotradeservswapleg
